evidence_limit: Authored translation and offline execution contracts. Narrow counters, Cartesian source routine conversions and inherited STRING-array capacities do not establish native compiler acceptance, ABI, physical storage or controller behavior.

narrow_for.storage: Captured BYTE/SHORT names, fresh locals, fields, ARRAY leaves and USING aliases retain ordinary whole-root protection and lexical private identities
narrow_for.bounds: Both bounds must fit the initialized counter domain: BYTE 0..255, SHORT -32768..32766; no wrapping, clamping or reserved-marker bounds
narrow_for.lifetime: Initial failure preserves prior storage; after checked initial assignment the counter registers cleanup, including final-bound failure; BYTE exit restores UNKNOWN_BYTE and SHORT exit restores UNINITIALIZED without changing ordinary Reference.clear
narrow_for.execution: Retain one selected leaf, final bound and iterator across structured/labelled/cooperative execution; no extra out-of-domain terminal write; jumps, failures, RETURN, ABORT and stop keep ordinary cleanup
narrow_for.boundary: No BYTE UNINIT, REAL/BOOLEAN/resource/CONFIG counters, writable active aliases, retained writable private aliases or native counter equivalence

cartesian_interfaces.arguments: Exact matching bare storage remains a reference; differing POSITION/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT actuals convert once in argument order to independent checked writable values without copy-back
cartesian_interfaces.returns: Source RETURN converts before frame and counter cleanup; preserve complete-input, proper orientation matrix, CONFIG, canonical ZYX and external-axis zero/drop rules
cartesian_interfaces.effects: Private converted formal writes do not alias caller storage; explicit global and selector effects retain ordinary transitive proofs and completed side effects
cartesian_interfaces.boundary: JOINTPOS, whole ARRAY elements, BYNAME, linked declared signatures and raw callback result types remain exact; no inferred robot/frame/group/model or native ABI

inherited_string_array_results.declarations: Anonymous ARRAY results may omit STRING element capacity with existing fixed, wildcard or mixed dimensions; infer concrete capacity from returned storage
inherited_string_array_results.validation: One actual concrete STRING capacity in 1..254, compatible anonymous outer representation/shape, checked known ASCII leaves and preserved missing markers; explicit bounded results remain exact
inherited_string_array_results.ownership: Return an independent checked copy before frame cleanup; keep actual capacity through grouping, forwarding, subscript access, linked results and saved context
inherited_string_array_results.boundary: No invented default, truncation, ragged/mixed capacities, named identity erasure, resource copies or native ABI; downstream whole-array interfaces still check actual capacity
